rules.name: Buy SCO next week (long-only oil short)
rules.how: Buy SCO (ProShares UltraShort Bloomberg Crude Oil, -2x daily crude) at the Friday close, sell at the next Friday close. It is 2x leveraged: half the dollar size gives about the exposure of a 1x oil short. It resets daily, so do not hold it longer than the week.
rules.no_extend_note: Do not hold SCO past this exit, even at a loss: since 2010, 5 of 11 losing SCO trades never got back to +1%.

rules.name: Buy XLU next week (high-probability defensive)
rules.how: Buy XLU (Utilities Select Sector SPDR) at the Friday close, sell at the next Friday close. The higher-probability, lower-risk companion to SCO: since 2010 it won 68% of these weeks (normal week 56%), avg +0.87%, 1-in-10 bad week about -2.8%. Not leveraged.
rules.take_profit_note: Since 2010 a +2.5% take profit won 70% vs 68% holding, but the average fell to +0.74% from +0.87%.

rules.name: Buy SPY next week (fear collapsed)
rules.how: Buy SPY (SPDR S&P 500) at the Friday close after VIX fell 5 points or more during the week, sell at the next Friday close. Stocks tend to keep rising as fear unwinds: since 2010 it won 67% of these weeks (normal week 58%), avg +0.85%, worst week -6.6%. Most of these weeks come within a month of a +3 spike.
rules.take_profit_note: Since 2010 a +1% take profit won 78% vs 67% holding, but the average fell to +0.72% from +0.85%.

rules.name: Buy SSO next week (2x S&P 500, fear collapsed)
rules.take_profit_note: Since 2010 a +1% take profit won 83% vs 67% holding, but the average fell to +1.25% from +1.70%.
rules.how: The 2x version of the SPY trade, same week: buy SSO (ProShares Ultra S&P 500) at the Friday close, sell at the next Friday close. Since 2010 it won 67% of these weeks, avg +1.70% (SPY +0.85%), worst week -13.2%. Use it in place of SPY, not on top of it, and size it at about half the SPY amount for the same risk.

rules.name: Buy SVOL next week (fear easing from a high level)
rules.trigger_text: Weekly Difference negative and VIX close 20 or above
rules.how: Buy SVOL (Simplify Volatility Premium: a small short-VIX-futures position with crash protection) at the Friday close, sell at the next Friday close. Since 2021 it won 71% of these weeks (normal week 56%), avg +1.11%, walk-forward 73%, worst week -6.1%. It is a volatility product: size it small and never on margin.

rules.name: Oil lower next week
rules.how: The underlying move. If you can only buy, use the SCO rule; CL=F on Yahoo is a front-month series with roll jumps.

rules.name: Short natural gas next week
rules.how: NG=F futures or UNG. Watch only: the edge is not statistically significant.

rules.name: Long GLD next week
rules.how: Buy GLD (SPDR Gold Shares, tracks gold bullion) at the Friday close, sell at the next Friday close. Watch only: the edge is weak and not statistically significant.

rules.name: VIX lower next week
rules.how: Not directly tradable. A risk read; the non-VIX way to trade it is selling SPY or SPX option premium, which is untested here.

rules.note: Since 2010 QQQ rose the next day 64% of 117 times after VIX closed 3+ points above its open (normal day 54%), avg +0.58%, walk-forward 64%, worst day -6.3%.
rules.trigger_text: VIX closes 3+ points above its open

rules.note: Since 2010 GLD rose over the next 5 days 63% of 86 times after VIX closed 3+ points below its open (normal 53%), avg +1.05%, walk-forward 66%, worst -9.1%.
rules.trigger_text: VIX closes 3+ points below its open
